survivors.rule: .claude/rules/journal.md — A Coinbase borrow/paydown is journal-only at EVERY dayLog reader

proposedTest.title: A Coinbase borrow/paydown is journal-only at EVERY dayLog reader — monthOf names no month for a Coinbase draw

survivors.rule: .claude/rules/journal.md — A buy's dollars are the owner's
survivors.why: monthEntryCurrent's lag check counts journal-only events, so a Coinbase draw logged after the sign-off makes a current entry read stale and a dollars-only buy edit reopens the month.
survivors.input: entry month 1 {source:'daily', btcBought:0.01, updatedAt:100}; dayLog: buy 0.01 ₿/$650 ts 50, Coinbase draw $1,000 ts 200 (same month)

proposedTest.title: A buy's dollars are the owner's — a Coinbase borrow logged after the sign-off leaves the month's entry current

survivors.rule: .claude/rules/journal.md — Strike collateral (v20 Collateral-Truth)

proposedTest.title: Strike collateral (v20 Collateral-Truth) — a deposit backfilled before the anchor reading is not re-summed

survivors.rule: .claude/rules/journal.md — Strike collateral (v20 Collateral-Truth)
survivors.why: The anchor pick loses its ts tiebreak; on a same-day tie array order wins instead of the later ts.

proposedTest.title: Strike collateral (v20 Collateral-Truth) — a same-day tie anchors on the later ts, not array order

survivors.rule: docs/claude/journal.md § Coinbase borrow & paydown events (journal-only; store unchanged, NO bump)
survivors.why: unreconciledCbFlows anchors by ts instead of (date, ts), so an older backfilled reading becomes the anchor and an absorbed borrow is reported stale.
survivors.input: readings: 2026-01-20 ts10 cbBal 70000; 2026-01-05 ts30 cbBal 50000; Coinbase draw $10,000 dated 2026-01-10 ts20

proposedTest.title: Coinbase borrow & paydown events — the anchor is the latest CB reading by date, then ts
proposedTest.assertion: const r = unreconciledCbFlows(log); expect(r.events).toHaveLength(0); expect(r.anchorCbBal).toBe(70000); expect(r.suggestedCbBal).toBe(70000)
